slackLink.hint: Changed the email address on your Slack account? Check again so the next notification finds you.
slackLink.linked: Your Slack account is linked. Direct messages will arrive there.
slackLink.notLinked: Slack has no account for your VeloExpense email address, so Slack notifications cannot be delivered.
slackLink.relinked: Cleared. Your Slack account will be looked up again with your next notification.
slackLink.title: Slack account
slackLink.unknown: Your Slack account hasn't been looked up yet. That happens automatically the first time a Slack notification is sent to you.

digest.intro: Here's a summary of recent activity:

receiptsEmail.filedBody: {count} receipt(s) filed on report {number}. VeloExpense is reading them now — the merchant, date, amount and tax will fill in shortly.
receiptsEmail.noAccountSubject: No VeloExpense account for this address
receiptsEmail.noAccountBody: This address does not have a VeloExpense account, so the receipts could not be filed. Send them from the address you sign in with.
receiptsEmail.noReceiptsBody: No receipt was attached, so nothing was created. Attach a photo or a PDF and send it again.
receiptsEmail.notEditableSubject: That report can no longer be changed
receiptsEmail.notEditableBody: That expense report has already been submitted, so receipts cannot be added to it. Recall it in VeloExpense first, or send a new email to start another report.
receiptsEmail.capReachedSubject: Your plan’s expense limit has been reached
receiptsEmail.capReachedBody: Your organization has added as many expenses this year as its plan allows, so these receipts could not be filed. Ask an administrator about the plan.

summary.heading: Your receipts are on {number}
summary.lead: {count} receipt(s) from your email are filed on report {number}.
summary.allRead: VeloExpense has read them. Check the details, then submit the report when you are ready.
summary.stillReading: {count} still being read; their details will fill in on the report shortly.
summary.couldNotRead: {count} could not be read; open the report and enter their details by hand.
summary.approverPool: an eligible approver, assigned when you submit
summary.approverAuto: None needed — approved automatically when you submit
summary.replyToAdd: Reply to this email to add more receipts to the same report.
summary.footer: You received this because you emailed receipts to VeloExpense from this address.

emailFooter: You are receiving this because of your notification settings in VeloExpense.
emailReplyHint: Replying to this email adds a comment to the thread.

email.replyToDiscuss: Or reply to this email to start a discussion.
